title: Yggdrasil Server Technical Specification
description: Complete JSON Schema for the Yggdrasil authentication server (authlib-injector). Covers all data models, API request/response formats, error formats, and metadata structures. Character encoding: UTF-8. All APIs use HTTPS with Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8 unless otherwise specified.

UnsignedUUID.description: UUID with all hyphen characters removed.

AccessToken.description: An arbitrary string (can be unsigned UUID or JWT) randomly generated by the server. Serves as a primary key due to its randomness.

ClientToken.description: An arbitrary string (can be unsigned UUID) provided by the client. Not unique.

Email.description: User email address. Must be unique. Can be changed.

Timestamp.description: Java timestamp format: milliseconds elapsed since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.

TextureModel.description: Skin texture model. 'default' = normal arm width (4px), 'slim' = thin arm width (3px).

TextureURL.description: URL of the texture. The filename (last segment after '/') is used as the texture hash. Content-Type must be image/png.

SkinModel.description: Skin model for upload. 'slim' = thin arm skin, empty string '' = normal skin.

ProfileName.description: Profile (character) name. Globally unique but changeable. Should not be used as identifier.

Base64Signature.description: Digital signature of the property value, Base64 encoded. Algorithm: SHA1withRSA (PKCS #1).

PEMPublicKey.description: PEM-formatted public key for verifying digital signatures. Starts with -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY----- and ends with -----END PUBLIC KEY-----. Newlines allowed between, no other whitespace.

ServerId.description: A random string generated cooperatively by the Minecraft server and client for session validation.

UploadableTexturesValue.description: Comma-separated list of uploadable texture types. Possible values: 'skin', 'cape', 'skin,cape'. If absent, no textures can be uploaded.

TokenState.description: Token state. 'VALID' = can perform all operations. 'TEMPORARILY_DISABLED' = can only refresh. 'INVALID' = cannot perform any operations. State transitions are irreversible: VALID -> TEMPORARILY_DISABLED -> INVALID, or VALID -> INVALID.

SkinDomainRule.description: Texture domain whitelist rule. If starts with '.', matches domains ending with this rule (e.g. '.example.com' matches 'a.example.com'). If does not start with '.', matches exact domain only.

TextureHash.description: SHA-256 hash (or other secure hash) of the texture image, used as the texture identifier and filename in the texture URL.

UnsignedParam.description: Query parameter controlling whether digital signatures are included in response.

TextureTypeParam.description: Texture type in URL path parameter.

HomepageURL.description: Homepage URL of the authentication server.

RegisterURL.description: Registration page URL of the authentication server.

ALIHeader.description: HTTP response header X-Authlib-Injector-API-Location. Value is a relative or absolute URL pointing to the associated Yggdrasil API. Used for service discovery.

TextureMetadata.description: Metadata for a texture. Currently known key: 'model' with value 'default' or 'slim' for SKIN textures.

TextureEntry.description: A single texture entry within the textures object.

TexturesPayload.description: The textures property value (Base64-encoded JSON string). Contains texture information for a profile.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when this property value was generated.

textures.description: Profile textures. Keys are texture types (SKIN, CAPE). Only include textures the profile has.

ProfileProperty.description: A profile property entry. May include a digital signature in certain contexts.

name.description: Property name. Known values: 'textures' (Base64-encoded JSON of texture info), 'uploadableTextures' (comma-separated list of uploadable texture types).

signature.description: Digital signature of the property value. Only included in specific contexts (e.g., session join response).

User.description: User information. A system can have multiple users. Each user has an ID (unsigned UUID), email, and password. Email is unique and changeable.

Profile.description: Profile (character) information. Profile-to-account is many-to-one. A profile corresponds to a player entity in Minecraft. Has UUID, name, skin model (default/slim), and textures. Both UUID and name are globally unique, but name can change. UUID is the recommended identifier.

properties.description: Profile properties array. Only included in specific contexts. Known properties: 'textures' (Base64-encoded JSON string of texture info), 'uploadableTextures' (comma-separated list: 'skin', 'cape', 'skin,cape').

ProfileWithProperties.description: Profile that must include properties (with optional signatures). Used in session join responses and profile queries.

ProfileWithoutProperties.description: Profile without properties. Used in batch name-to-profile queries.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response format for all APIs.

error.description: Brief machine-readable error description. Known values: 'ForbiddenOperationException', 'IllegalArgumentException'.

cause.description: Optional cause of the error. Generally not included unless specified.

MetaLinks.description: Server URL links displayed in launchers.

Meta.description: Server metadata. All fields are optional.

links.description: Server URL links for launcher display.

feature.non_email_login.description: Whether the server supports login with credentials other than email (e.g. profile name). Default: false.

feature.legacy_skin_api.description: (Advanced) Whether the server supports the legacy skin API (GET /skins/MinecraftSkins/{username}.png). Default: false.

feature.no_mojang_namespace.description: (Advanced) Whether to disable authlib-injector's Mojang namespace (@mojang suffix) feature. Default: false.

feature.enable_mojang_anti_features.description: (Advanced) Whether to enable Minecraft's anti-features. Default: false.

feature.enable_profile_key.description: (Advanced) Whether the server supports Minecraft's message signing key pair feature (chat message digital signatures in multiplayer). Default: false. When enabled, Minecraft uses POST /minecraftservices/player/certificates to obtain key pairs.

feature.username_check.description: (Advanced) Whether authlib-injector enables username validation. Default: false. When enabled, players with special characters in usernames cannot join servers.

additionalProperties.description: Additional custom metadata fields are allowed.

MetadataResponse.description: Response for GET / (metadata API). Used by authlib-injector for auto-configuration.

meta.description: Server metadata object. Content is flexible.

skinDomains.description: Texture domain whitelist. Minecraft only downloads textures from whitelisted domains. Default rules: '.minecraft.net', '.mojang.com'. Rules starting with '.' match domains ending with that rule; rules not starting with '.' match exact domain.

signaturePublickey.description: PEM-formatted public key for verifying profile property digital signatures.

AuthenticateRequest.description: Request for POST /authserver/authenticate. Authenticates with password and issues a new token.

username.description: Email (or other credential if feature.non_email_login is enabled, e.g. profile name).

clientToken.description: Optional. Client-specified clientToken. If not provided, server generates a random unsigned UUID.

requestUser.description: Whether to include user info in response. Default: false.

availableProfiles.description: List of profiles available to the user.

selectedProfile.description: Bound profile. If user has no profiles, omit. If user has one profile, typically bound to it. If user has multiple profiles, typically null for client selection. Omit if null.

user.description: User info. Only included when requestUser is true in the request.

RefreshRequest.description: Request for POST /authserver/refresh. Revokes the old token and issues a new one.

clientToken.description: Optional. When specified, server checks both accessToken and clientToken; otherwise only checks accessToken.

requestUser.description: Whether to include user info in response. Default: false.

selectedProfile.description: Optional. When specified, this is a profile selection operation. Requires the old token's bound profile to be null. The new token will be bound to this profile.

clientToken.description: New token's clientToken. Should be the same as the old token's.

selectedProfile.description: New token's bound profile. Omit if null.

user.description: User info. Only included when requestUser is true in the request.

ValidateRequest.description: Request for POST /authserver/validate. Checks if a token is valid.

clientToken.description: Optional. When specified, server checks both accessToken and clientToken; otherwise only checks accessToken.

InvalidateRequest.description: Request for POST /authserver/invalidate. Revokes the given token.

clientToken.description: Optional. Server only checks accessToken; clientToken value has no effect.

SignoutRequest.description: Request for POST /authserver/signout. Revokes all tokens for the user.

JoinServerRequest.description: Request for POST /sessionserver/session/minecraft/join. Records the serverId sent by the server to the client. Server should store: serverId, accessToken, client IP in an in-memory database (e.g. Redis) with expiration (e.g. 30 seconds).

selectedProfile.description: The bound profile's UUID (unsigned). Must match the token's bound profile.

HasJoinedServerResponse.description: Response for GET /sessionserver/session/minecraft/hasJoined. Returns the full profile info with properties and digital signatures if the session is valid. Returns HTTP 204 No Content if invalid.

ProfileQueryResponse.description: Response for GET /sessionserver/session/minecraft/profile/{uuid}. Returns profile info with properties. Includes digital signatures unless unsigned=true. Returns HTTP 204 No Content if profile does not exist.

BatchProfileQueryRequest.description: Request for POST /api/profiles/minecraft. Batch query profiles by names. Max query count should be enforced (at least 2) to prevent CC attacks.

BatchProfileQueryResponse.description: Response for POST /api/profiles/minecraft. Returns found profiles without properties. Non-existent profiles are omitted. Order is not guaranteed.

TextureUploadRequest.description: Request for PUT /api/user/profile/{uuid}/{textureType}. Content-Type: multipart/form-data. Requires Authorization: Bearer {accessToken} header. Returns 401 if missing or invalid.

model.description: (Skin only) Skin model. 'slim' for thin arm skin, '' (empty) for normal skin.

file.description: Texture image file. Content-Type must be image/png. Recommended to set Content-Disposition filename parameter. Server must: 1) Check image dimensions (skin: 64x32 or 64x64 multiples; cape: 64x32 or 22x17 multiples), 2) Verify it is a valid skin/cape texture, 3) Re-save the image to strip non-bitmap metadata (security: prevent RCE and DoS).

Token.description: Token (login credential). Token-to-account is many-to-one. Tokens are time-limited. A user can have multiple tokens (recommended limit: 10; revoke oldest when exceeded).

accessToken.description: Randomly generated by the server. Can serve as primary key.

clientToken.description: Provided by the client. Not unique.

boundProfile.description: Bound profile UUID. Can be null. Represents the profile that can use this token for gameplay.

expiresAfter.description: Token expiration period in milliseconds (e.g. 15 days = 1296000000 ms).

requestBody.description: Request body schema reference or null for GET/DELETE.

requiresAuth.description: Whether the endpoint requires Authorization header.

rateLimited.description: Whether the endpoint should be rate-limited.

rateLimitTarget.description: Rate limit target. Should be per-user, not per-IP.

contentType.description: Required content type for texture uploads.

hashAlgorithm.description: Recommended hash algorithm for texture hash. SHA-256 or more secure.

securityChecks.description: Required security checks for uploaded textures.

randomV4.description: Generate random Version 4 UUID (default when no compatibility needed).

offlineCompatible.description: Generate UUID from profile name for offline-mode compatibility. Formula: UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(("OfflinePlayer:" + characterName).getBytes(UTF_8)). Enables bidirectional compatibility with offline authentication.

preserveExisting.description: Preserve UUID from previous authentication system during migration to prevent data loss.

CompleteSpecification.description: Complete Yggdrasil server specification encompassing all data models, API endpoints, security constraints, and configuration.

apiEndpoints.description: All API endpoints grouped by category.

username.description: Profile name. Must match the name of the profile bound to the token associated with serverId.

serverId.description: The serverId sent by the server to the client.

ip.description: Optional. Client IP obtained by the Minecraft server. Only included when prevent-proxy-connections is enabled.

description.const: Query full profile info by UUID.

unsigned.description: Whether to exclude digital signatures. Default: true.

description.const: Batch query profiles by names. Max query count at least 2.
Upload a texture for the profile.
Clear a texture for the profile (reverts to default).
Get server metadata for authlib-injector auto-configuration.

aliHeader.description: HTTP response header for API Location Indication (ALI). Value is a relative or absolute URL pointing to the associated Yggdrasil API. Enables service discovery so users only need to enter a domain associated with the API.

textureUrlContentType.description: Texture URL response Content-Type must be image/png to prevent Sniffing Attacks.

primaryKey.description: Use serverId as primary key due to its randomness.
